AdapterInfo.description: An npm package that connects an agent to ACP, installed by Burrow at a pinned version.

path.description: The folder it is, or will be, installed in.

AgentId.description: Which agent: the four Burrow drives, plus a scripted fake for tests.

oneOf.description: A scripted fake agent for tests and trying things by hand. Listed only when `burrowd` runs with `--dev`.

AgentInfo.description: What `burrowd` found out about one agent.

adapter.description: The ACP adapter Burrow installs and runs for this agent, when it needs one (Claude Code and Codex). `agent/install` installs it.

agentModes.description: The agent's own modes, what `session/create`'s `agentMode` accepts: known for Muse and the fakes, otherwise the modes of the agent's latest session. Empty when unknown.

available.description: Whether `session/create` can start this agent now.

defaultAgentMode.description: The agent mode Burrow starts sessions in when `session/create` doesn't name one, for example Claude Code's `default`. Absent when Burrow keeps the agent's own default.

login.description: Whether the CLI is logged in.

models.description: Models the agent offers, when they are cheap to find out. Empty when unknown.

name.description: Its display name, for example `Claude Code`.

problem.description: Why it isn't available, or what looks wrong. Human-readable.

version.description: The CLI's version, as it reports it.

agent.description: The agent whose adapter to install.

account.description: The account, when the CLI reports it, for example an email address.

detail.description: More detail, as the CLI reports it, for example the plan or "no subscription allowance".

state.description: Logged in, logged out, or unknown.

AgentMessageChunk.description: `agentMessageChunk`: a piece of the agent's answer. Stored in chunks of about 100 ms; a client appends consecutive chunks of a turn.

text.description: The text, usually Markdown, to append to the answer so far.

AgentMode.description: One of an agent's own modes, such as "ask before edits" or "plan only".

description.description: What the mode does, as the agent describes it.

AgentThoughtChunk.description: `agentThoughtChunk`: a piece of the agent's visible reasoning.

ArtifactRef.description: An immutable file in the artifact store, addressed by its SHA-256 hash.

hash.description: `sha256:` followed by the content's hash in lowercase hex.

CancelParams.description: `$/cancel` params: which of the sender's own pending requests to cancel. The receiver should stop and answer that request with the error `cancelled`.

id.description: The id of the request to cancel.

ClientCapabilities.description: What the client can do. Every capability defaults to off when absent.

mediaTypes.description: Media types the client can display, for example `image/png`.

ClientInfo.description: The client's name, version and kind.

kind.description: What sort of client this is.

version.description: The client's own version, for example `0.1.0`.

ClientKind.description: What sort of client is connecting.

oneOf.description: A custom step process, in RPC mode (the step protocol).

CodeHost.description: A code host Burrow knows how to work with.

oneOf.description: A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

ContentBlock.description: A piece of prompt or message content. Follows ACP, except that images are artifact references instead of inline data.

oneOf.description: An image from the artifact store. Defined, but `session/prompt` doesn't accept it yet.
A resource, such as a file, by URI. Defined, but `session/prompt` doesn't accept it yet.

DebugAppendParams.description: `debug/append` params: append one event to a stream.

event.description: The event to append. Unknown event types are stored as sent.

stream.description: The stream to append to. Any name is allowed, including ones `burrowd` doesn't use itself.

seq.description: The new event's sequence number in its stream.

Empty.description: An empty object, `{}`: the params of `$/ping` and the result of methods that return nothing. Any members are ignored.

EntityCreated.description: `entityCreated`: a project, session or run now exists.

agent.description: The agent, for sessions, so a list entry needs no `session/get`.

projectId.description: The project it belongs to, for sessions and runs.

state.description: Its initial state, for entities that have one (a session or run state).

title.description: Its display name: a project's name, or a session's or run's title.

EntityKind.description: The kind of entity an `index` event is about.

oneOf.description: A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

EntityRemoved.description: `entityRemoved`: the entity left the default lists. A project was removed, or a session or run was archived.

EntityStateChanged.description: `entityStateChanged`: an entity moved to a new state, or, for a session, its last activity moved.

lastActivityAt.description: A session's `lastActivityAt`, so a list sorted by activity can re-sort without `session/get`. Always present on session events from `burrowd`.

state.description: The state: one of the session states or run states in protocol.md. Kept as a string so new states don't break older clients. Usually a new state; the same state when only `lastActivityAt` moved.

ErrorData.description: `error.data`: the error kind plus details that only some kinds carry.

kind.description: What went wrong. Absent on standard JSON-RPC errors.

resetsAt.description: `limitReached`: when the limit resets, if known.

supported.description: `versionMismatch`: the protocol versions the server supports.

ErrorKind.description: Why a Burrow request failed. Sent in `error.data.kind`; clients branch on this.

oneOf.description: The entity doesn't exist, or this device can't see it.
Not allowed in the entity's current state, for example prompting a stopped session.
Someone else got there first, for example the inbox item was already answered.
Not authenticated, or the device lacks the permission.
A provider limit was hit. `data.resetsAt` gives the reset time when known.
Incompatible protocol versions. `data.supported` lists the supported ones.
Something needed is missing, for example the agent isn't installed.
A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

ErrorObject.description: The `error` member of a failed response.

code.description: A JSON-RPC error code: a standard one, or one of Burrow's, `-32001` to `-32008`.

data.description: Burrow's structured details. Always present on Burrow's own errors; may be absent on standard JSON-RPC errors.

message.description: A human-readable description. Clients show it but never branch on it.

Event.description:
One event in a stream, tagged by `type`.

Event `type` names are unique across all streams. A receiver must accept a `type` it doesn't know, show it as an unsupported event and keep going. In Rust it decodes as `Event::Unknown`, which keeps the raw JSON.

InboxAction.description: One possible answer to an inbox item.

id.description: The action's id, sent as `action` in `inbox/respond`.

InboxActionStyle.description: How to draw an inbox action.

oneOf.description: An answer that refuses or destroys something.

InboxItem.description: Something that waits on a human.

actions.description: The possible answers. For a permission request, the agent's options.

attachments.description: Files to look at before answering.

closedAt.description: When it was resolved or expired.

expiresAt.description: When it expires on its own, if it does.

form.description: A JSON Schema for a structured answer, sent as `payload`, for example a feedback field.

InboxItemAdded.description: `inboxItemAdded`: something now waits on a human. Enough for a list entry or a phone notification; `inbox/get` has the rest.

actions.description: The possible answers, as in the item, so a client can show its buttons without `inbox/get`. Absent from older `burrowd`s.

InboxItemKind.description: What an inbox item asks for.

oneOf.description: Approve or reject something, for example a plan.
Pick one of several options, for example one of 4 images.
Do something by hand, then confirm.
An agent asks for permission to use a tool.
Something needs a human to step in, for example a review loop that doesn't converge.
A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

InboxItemResolved.description: `inboxItemResolved`: an inbox item no longer needs an answer.

action.description: The id of the action chosen. Absent when the item expired.

by.description: Who answered: a device id, or `local`. Absent when the item expired.

before.description: Only items created before this one: pass the last id of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many. Default 100, at most 1000.

status.description: Only items with this status. All of them when absent.

InboxResolution.description: How an inbox item was answered.

by.description: Who answered: a device id, or `local`.

payload.description: The structured answer, if the item has a `form`.

action.description: One of the item's action ids.

payload.description: The structured answer, if the item has a `form`.

InboxSource.description: Where an inbox item comes from. Every member is optional.

toolCallId.description: The tool call a permission request is about, within `sessionId`.

protocolVersion.description: The protocol version the client speaks. Version 0 must match the server's exactly.

connectionId.description: This connection's id (`con_…`). Remote clients sign it during authentication.

protocolVersion.description: The protocol version the server speaks.

Integration.description: How Burrow talks to an agent.

oneOf.description: The agent's own TUI in a pseudo-terminal.
The fake agent's own trivial protocol.

LimitInfo.description: A provider limit that was hit.

provider.description: The provider whose limit it is, for example `claude`.

LimitReached.description: `limitReached`: a provider limit was hit. The session becomes `limited`.

resetsAt.description: When the limit resets, if known.

LoginState.description: Whether the agent's CLI is logged in.

oneOf.description: Logged in; sessions can use the account.
Not logged in. Log in with the agent's own CLI.
A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

Message.description: Any one JSON-RPC 2.0 message: one line on the named pipe or stdin/stdout, or one WebSocket text frame.

ModelChanged.description: `modelChanged`: the session now uses another model.

id.description: The id to pass as `model`, for example `gpt-5.3-codex`.

Notification.description: A one-way message. It gets no response.

PermissionOption.description: One answer the agent offers to a permission request.

oneOf.description: Allow this and similar calls from now on.
Refuse this and similar calls from now on.
A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

inboxItemId.description: The inbox item that holds the question.

title.description: What the agent wants to do, for example `Edit README.md`.

toolCallId.description: The tool call it is about.

PermissionResolved.description: `permissionResolved`: a permission request was answered, or expired because the turn was cancelled, the session stopped or `burrowd` restarted.

by.description: Who answered: a device id, or `local`. Absent when it expired.

optionId.description: The option chosen. Absent when it expired.

toolCallId.description: The tool call it was about.

Plan.description: `plan`: the agent's current plan, replacing any earlier one.

PlanEntry.description: One step of an agent's plan.

oneOf.description: A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.
A value added by a newer protocol revision. Keep it and pass it on.

Project.description: A local folder Burrow works in, usually a git repository.

name.description: The display name: the folder's name.

remote.description: The git `origin` remote, when the folder is a git repository that has one.

path.description: The folder, as an absolute path. Adding a folder that is already a project returns that project.

host.description: The code host, when Burrow recognises it. Absent for other hosts.

owner.description: The repository's owner on the code host, for example `traista-eugen`.

repo.description: The repository's name on the code host, for example `burrow`.

url.description: The remote's URL, as git reports it.

ProjectSettings.description: A project's settings. Empty for now: role overrides, the check command, `autoMerge` and default flows arrive with the features that use them. Unknown members are ignored.

ProviderUsage.description: One provider's usage and limit, as last reported. Every figure is optional: providers report different things.

limited.description: Whether the provider's limit has been reached.

message.description: The provider's own words, for example the message that came with a limit.

provider.description: The provider, for example `claude`. By default the id of the agent that reported it.

resetsAt.description: When the limit resets, if known.

unit.description: The unit of `used` and `limit`, for example `tokens`, `requests`, `usd` or `percent`.

used.description: How much of the allowance is used, in `unit`.

Request.description: A call that expects a response with the same id.

id.description: Chosen by the sender; the response carries it back.

params.description: The method's params. Burrow's methods take an object; absent means `{}`.

RequestId.description: A request id: an integer or a string, unique among the sender's pending requests.

Response.description: The answer to a request: a result or an error, never both.

id.description: The id of the request being answered. `null` only on an error about a line whose id couldn't be read.

version.description: The server's own version, for example `0.1.0`.

agentMode.description: The agent's own mode, for example Claude Code's `default` or Codex's `read-only`. It decides what the agent asks permission for. Absent when the agent has no modes.

archived.description: Archived sessions leave the default lists.

cwd.description: The folder the agent works in.

title.description: The display name. Set from the first prompt when `session/create` didn't give one; `session/rename` changes it.

usage.description: Tokens and cost so far, when the agent reports them.

agentMode.description: The agent's own mode to start in, for example `read-only`. When absent, the agent's `defaultAgentMode` from `agent/list`, or else the agent's own default.

mode.description: Structured (the default) or terminal. Terminal sessions are `unavailable` until M4.

model.description: The model to use; the agent's default when absent.

before.description: Only sessions that come after this one in the list's order (most recent activity first): pass the last id of the previous page.

includeArchived.description: Include archived sessions, which are left out by default.

limit.description: At most this many. Default 100, at most 1000.

model.description: The model's id, as the agent knows it.

costUsd.description: Cost in US dollars, when the agent reports it.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens, summed over every `usage` event.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens, summed over every `usage` event.

StateChanged.description: `stateChanged`: the session moved to a new state.

reason.description: Why, when it isn't obvious: for example why it stopped or failed.

StreamEvent.description: `events/event` params: one event from a subscribed stream.

seq.description: The event's position in its stream, from 1, with no gaps.

stream.description: The stream the event belongs to.

after.description: Replay events with a `seq` greater than this, then follow live. Leave it out to receive only new events; `0` replays the full history.

rawInput.description: The tool's raw input, as the agent sent it, for display.
